About Us

Your Skin Deserves Expert Care

Welcome to Holistic Dermatology & Aesthetic Speciality Clinic, where science meets beauty in Bahir Dar. Led by Dr. Feiza Seid, our clinic brings you cutting-edge skincare solutions delivered with compassion and expertise.

Our board-certified dermatologist and skilled team use only the finest, clinically-proven treatments to address your unique skin concerns. From acne to advanced laser therapies, every consultation is tailored specifically to you.

We believe beautiful skin transforms confidence. Join thousands of happy patients who trust us with their skin health. Your journey to radiant, healthy skin begins here.
